title: Paul urges Euodia and Syntyke to be of one mind
description: Paul urges Euodia and Syntyke to be of one mind in the Lord, and asks a faithful companion to help these women who have struggled alongside him in the gospel, together with Clement and his other fellow workers whose names are in the book of life. [ref: Phil 4:2-3|Philippians 4:2-3]
